description: START ... FIRST/LAST positioning, ISO §2023:14.9.41 — introduced 2002 (provisional edge, derived: VCR row 7.38). ONE construct for every organization: the general format prints one phrase, so GR11/GR12 (RELATIVE), GR18/GR19 (INDEXED) and GR20/GR21 (SEQUENTIAL) of §2023:14.9.41.4 carry one edition band (kb/Work PB870)
citation: ISO §2023:14.9.41.2 (the FIRST and LAST phrases of the general format); §2023:14.9.41.4 GR11
vcr: START FIRST/LAST (post-85; provisional 2002 edge); VCR row 7.38
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. SF.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT F ASSIGN TO "vmsf" ORGANIZATION IS RELATIVE
        ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC RELATIVE KEY IS W-K.
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD F.
01 R PIC X(10).
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W-K PIC 9(4).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN I-O F.
    START F FIRST INVALID KEY DISPLAY "E".
    CLOSE F.
    STOP RUN.
